column1: # Secondary run: NA12878, PacBio Onso (PE100), Twist Exome 2.x capture.
# Selected by:  run --configfile config/twist_onso.yaml --cores 8 all benchmark
# HEADS UP: unlike the default Garvan/Nextera sheet, these FASTQs are NOT
# publicly documented anywhere in this repo -- they were obtained locally and no
# download URL is known. If you are not the author, you cannot fetch this data;
# use the default config instead. Kept here because the 8-plex pool is the
# highest-depth NA12878 exome available to this project and is useful as a
# depth-sensitivity comparison.
# FULL 8-PLEX POOL: all 8 libraries are the SAME sample (NA12878), so they are
# 8 sequencing units of one sample -> pooled to raise depth.
# PL:ILLUMINA - Onso emits Illumina-compatible short reads; the PL tag is
# cosmetic for this short-read pipeline (bwa-mem / GATK do not branch on it).
# NOTE ON KIT MATCHING: this data is Twist Exome 2.1 (Exome2pt1_STv2_EFv2) but
# the BED that config/twist_onso.yaml selects is Twist 2.0.2 -- the closest
# public design. They are not identical, so regions enriched by 2.1 but absent
# from 2.0.2 (and vice versa) contribute apparent false negatives that are a
# capture artefact, not a calling error.
